notes.title: Added Hard mode
notes.notes:
Added Hard mode.
Added a highlight on the path when a level is cleared.

notes.title: Full Keyboard Support
notes.notes:
Added support for keyboard-only play.
[list]
[*] WASD to hear surrounding notes
[*] ENTER to open note fields
[*] SPACE to play/stop the music
[*] F and R to Forward and Reverse the music time slider
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Fix
notes.notes: Fix some notes that are still de same when there is a fork in the maze

notes.title: Window Mode and New Challenge
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added option to choose between window or fullscreen mode
[*] Added a challenge to exit the maze without hitting the Play button, e.g. without hearing the music first
[/list]

notes.title: Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added Main Menu music
[*] Main Menu buttons are now colored
[*] Increased music volume
[*] Fixed equal notes when maze forks
[/list]
